8.4.35 ActivateTaskAsyn
[SWS_Os_91022] Definition of API function ActivateTaskAsyn
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80015
⌈
Service Name
ActivateTaskAsyn
Syntax
void ActivateTaskAsyn (
TaskType id
)
Service ID [hex]
0x33
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
id
The id of the task to be activated
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Asynchronous version of the ActivateTask() function. Intended to be used for cross core task
activation. Possible errors are not returned to the caller, but may be reported via error hooks.
Available via
Os.h
⌋
[SWS_Os_00818]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80015
⌈Availability of ActivateTaskAsyn:
Available in systems which support OS-
Applications.⌋
Note: If during the Task activation an error occurs, and the caller is already gone (e.g.
callers OS-Application is already terminated, OR callers core is shutting down OR ...)
calls to error hooks are dropped and no reporting is done.
